notes.title: Killbot General selected for DemoNights and "Games From Quebec" events!
notes.content:
Things are getting real, and playtests are getting closer! 

Our team has been hard at work and Killbot General has been selected to feature in the [b]DemoNights streaming event[/b]. There, you will be able to see a five-minute gameplay reveal and presentation on Saturday night, February 22, at 8pm Eastern on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lotoquebec]https://www.twitch.tv/lotoquebec[/url]

Also, the game will be part of the "[b]Games from Quebec[/b]" Steam event. Although there is no playable demo yet, there are goodies coming soon and it's still cool for us to be part of their biggest regional event on Steam. :)

Things will be picking up in the coming weeks, [b]follow or wishlist the game to be the first to know[/b]!

notes.title: Announcing Killbot General
notes.content:
After years of development, our tiny team is excited to bring you the unhinged, real-time tactics universe of the Killbots!

Create a customized cause and lead it to glory as its hero Killbot General in the crazy and irreverent, dynamic (choices matter!) story campaign, in solo or co-op. Controller-friendly, with emphasis on tactics, not speed or micromanagement.

Get a taste of the crazy universe of Killbot General with the Botscaping video:

https://youtu.be/8ZTESKHWU0M
